name: timeline

frames.best_why: Two dated blocks with paired photos hang off one vertical line, unlike the single-entry first frame.

tagline: Years stack down a vertical line that fills with colour as you scroll.
summary: A changelog or journey laid out as dated entries: a bold year, a paragraph and paired photos, joined by a thin vertical line whose coloured section follows your scroll position.
appearance: A near-black page opens with a white heading and a short intro, then a column of dated entries. Each entry has a large grey year on the left, a small dot on a thin vertical rule, and text with two rounded photos on the right.
behaviour: Scrolling grows a purple-to-blue segment down the vertical rule in step with how far the list has been read. Year labels stick near the top while their own content scrolls past.
demo_content: Heading 'Changelog from my journey'; years 2024 to 2020 with sunset, mountain, street and laptop photos.
search_phrases: scroll progress line down a list
animated line that fills as you scroll
big year labels next to paragraphs
use_when: A past history such as a changelog, career or roadmap needs dates and media in one readable scroll.
avoid_when: Content must stay above the fold or the page cannot scroll, since the coloured line only draws on scroll.
customise: Entries arrive as a data array of year title plus content nodes; spacing, colours and the line gradient are set in the source.
weight_why: A handful of DOM nodes and two scroll-linked transforms, with no loops.

a11y.note: The scroll-linked line and sticky headings ignore reduced-motion, and the progress is decorative with no text alternative.

polish_why: Clear date hierarchy and a smoothly growing line; some photos look washed out in the capture.
title: Timeline
